desc:
🎣 YEET your bait as far as you can and catch rare fish!

💪 Train your power at your pond to throw farther
🌍 Explore twelve zones – the farther you throw, the rarer the fish and the higher your LUCK
💎 NEW: Crystal Caverns and Dragon's Lair with legendary new fish
🐟 Collect over eighty fish with rare mutations and HUGE sizes
🏠 Put fish in your aquarium to earn cash – even while offline!
🎣 Upgrade your rods & baits for more luck
🌈 Use Rainbow Bait for a massive LUCK throw
🥚 Hatch special eggs for powerful fish
📖 Complete the Fish Index, earn Fish Tokens and claim daily rewards
🏆 Climb the season leaderboards for exclusive rewards
🎮 Play on PC, mobile, tablet and console

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for new zones, fish and updates!
